text: tt_factory() meant called directly. tt_single(), tt_iterate(), tt_merge() append target_list <- target_list |> target_append(tt_factory(...)) script.

title: Building blocks of tidytargets
text: tt_initialise() can called inputs (script header store ). named list -memory objects, one element per unit iteration (e.g. sample), registers mapped targets. tt_data() adds session object later without splitting ; tt_data_list() adds list mapped units.
code: inputs <- list(   sample_a = 1:3,   sample_b = 4:6 )

title: Building blocks of tidytargets
text: writes {store}.R saves configuration. passed mapped inputs, also registers: input_list — named input vector list (override target_output) sample_names — names vector list computing_resources, pipeline sequential. store, unique ./tidytargets-<HASH> directory created. inputs, start tt_initialise() add objects tt_data(). Packages currently attached session (.packages()) recorded tt_initialise() names tar_option_set(packages = ) workers can library() . tt_initialise() messages list can check packages available HPC. Objects global environment copied; bring tt_data() user_function_source_path. Pass packages override snapshot. Attach libraries initialise (pass packages) later command needs .
code: pipe <- inputs |>   tt_initialise() #> tidytargets says: the store is ./tidytargets-1c7252d1d8a7 #> tidytargets says: these packages from the session will be loaded on workers: tidytargets, qs2 show_targets_script(pipe) ## tidytargets-1c7252d1d8a7.R      library(tidytargets)     do.call("library", list("dplyr"))     do.call("library", list("magrittr"))     do.call("library", list("targets"))     do.call("library", list("tarchetypes"))     do.call("library", list("qs2"))     lapply(character(0), function(pkg) do.call("library", list(pkg)))     tar_option_set(memory = "transient", garbage_collection = 0,          storage = "worker", retrieval = "worker", error = NULL,          debug = NULL, cue = tar_cue(mode = "thorough"), controller = qs_read("/tmp/RtmpC5B7rF/tidytargets-vignette-1c724c4fe8d9/tidytargets-1c7252d1d8a7/temp_computing_resources.qs"),          format = "qs", packages = c("tidytargets", "qs2"), trust_timestamps = TRUE,          workspace_on_error = FALSE)     target_list <- list() target_list <- target_list |> target_append( tt_factory(command = "/tmp/RtmpC5B7rF/tidytargets-vignette-1c724c4fe8d9/tidytargets-1c7252d1d8a7/sample_names.qs", target_output = "sample_names_file", format = "file") ) target_list <- target_list |> target_append( tt_factory(command = quote(qs_read(sample_names_file)), target_output = "sample_names", deployment = "main") ) target_list <- target_list |> target_append( tt_factory(command = "/tmp/RtmpC5B7rF/tidytargets-vignette-1c724c4fe8d9/tidytargets-1c7252d1d8a7/input_file.qs", target_output = "input_list_file", format = "file") ) target_list <- target_list |> target_append( tt_factory(command = quote(qs_read(input_list_file)), target_output = "input_list", deployment = "main") )
